name: sqlprojectreader-malformed-project-throws
body: Read reads each named .sqlproj with File.ReadAllText and parses it with ParseProject, unguarded, so any read or parse failure of one named project — a missing or unreadable file (FileNotFoundException, IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException) or malformed XML (XmlException) — throws out of Read and would abort the whole SQL scan; a .. Build Include that climbs above the repository root resolves to no repository path and matches no file without any report. Upgrade when SchemaEmitter.Run wires Read into the scan: catch any read or parse failure per project, write one sql: diagnostic for that .sqlproj, and treat that project's files as loose.
